plain_english: Oṃ hrīṃ, obeisance to the one clad in black, praised, destroyer of thousands in the universe, thousand-fold protector, greatly powerful, unconquered Pratyangira, destroyer of enemy armies and hostile actions, uprooter of others' mantras, subduer of all beings, bind all gods, cut all knowledge, agitate, shatter others' devices, break all chains, flame-tongued, terrible-faced Pratyangira, hrīṃ, obeisance.
